bio: Orsolina Zanetti is a remarkably prosperous facchino (porter) who has risen far beyond her humble beginnings through extraordinary business acumen and tireless work at the public docks. Born to a family of cargo handlers who have worked Venice's bustling port for generations, Orsolina learned the value of persistence and physical strength from an early age.
